messages:
jane_acme: Hey team — onboarding ACME (org id: acme-corp). Followed quickstart but all our calls return 401. We can't find any API keys in the Console under our project. Can someone help?

Sophie W: Sorry for the trouble, jane. A few quick things: are you in the right project dropdown (top-left)? Keys are per-project. Also check Console > Project settings > API keys.

jane_acme: Yep, double-checked. Project dropdown shows "ACME Product" and under Settings -> API Keys the list is empty. We tried creating a key but "Create" button is greyed out. No errors shown.

Mike L: Do you see any banners about billing or trial credits? Sometimes we block key creation if payment terms aren't accepted. Can you paste the exact 401 response body (no keys, just the JSON)?

jane_acme: Response is: `{\"error\":\"unauthorized\",\"message\":\"Invalid or missing API key\"}`. No banners. Billing page shows a new card added and status "Active".

BillingBot: (system) Org acme-corp pending terms acceptance: API key provisioning disabled. Please accept the Enterprise Terms at https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme-corp/terms to enable keys.

Sophie W: Ah — looks like our billing guard may be blocking key creation even if a card exists. @jane_acme can you open the org terms link and accept? If the UI doesn't let you, say so and we'll escalate.

jane_acme: I clicked the link, accepted terms, and I still don't see keys. The "Create API Key" is still disabled.

Mike L: Thanks — can you paste a screenshot of the Settings > API Keys section? Also run a quick browser hard refresh and confirm you're a Project Admin (only admins see/create keys).

jane_acme: Screenshot posted: https://acme.screenshots/frag.png — the create button is greyed out and I am an Admin (role: Owner).

Sophie W: Ok escalating to infra. @ops-oncall can you confirm if the org provisioning job succeeded for acme-corp? I suspect the background job that binds billing+roles -> keys flag failed.

ops-oncall: Investigating. I see a failed job in the provisioning queue for org=acme-corp at 2024-04-23T14:28:12Z. Error: `FailedToSetKeyFlagError: billing_terms_not_confirmed` but BillingBot says accepted. Checking reconciliation logs now.

ops-oncall: Follow-up: reconciliation worker retried but encountered a DB race updating the org_flags table (deadlock). I can manually flip the flags, but want infra to know — there's a retry timing window.

Karl (oncall): I'll manually create a temp key and attach it to the Project so jane can continue onboarding. Will also add a fix to retry strategy. Creating now...

Karl (oncall): Created temporary key with id redwood_tmp_ak_9Xw3. I DM'ed the secret to jane (one-time view). Please rotate after you confirm.

Sophie W: Jane — you should have a DM with the one-time key. Test like this:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_KEY_HERE>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"hi"}'
```

Sophie W: Expected success is a 200 with a generation payload. If you still get 401, paste the full request headers (no secret values) and we'll inspect.

jane_acme: Tested with the temp key — generation returns 200 and a sample output. Thanks! 

jane_acme: A couple follow-ups: 1) can you make the create button work so we can generate our own key? 2) Will this temp key be rate-limited / expiring?

Karl (oncall): The temp key is TTL-limited to 48 hours; you'll want to create a permanent key after we clear the provisioning bug. I'm marking the org as provisioned now (flag flipped). The create button should become active in ~1 minute — try logging out/in or hard refresh.

Sophie W: Action items recorded: 
- Incident INC-7891 created to fix DB deadlock and add safer retries (owner: eng-infra).
- Karl provided temp key; customer to rotate.
- Billing/terms flow has been reviewed and BillingBot will now surface the terms acceptance earlier in the flow.

Mike L: For internal notes / repro for engineering: Repro steps we recorded —
1) New org created via signup flow with payment method added but terms acceptance race.
2) Provisioning worker processes org and tries to set `api_keys_enabled` flag.
3) Concurrent billingWebhook triggers a DB update causing deadlock on `org_flags` table -> abort leaves `api_keys_enabled=false`.
4) UI shows Create button disabled.

Mike L: Temporary mitigation: add idempotent retry with exponential backoff on the provisioning worker and a verification pass that reconciles flags post-webhook. Permanent fix in INC-7891.

Sophie W: jane — can you confirm once you create your permanent key that everything looks correct? We'll keep the incident open until the fix is deployed.

jane_acme: Confirmed — I can create a permanent key now and calls succeed. Thanks everyone, especially Karl. :clap:

Sophie W: Closing the customer-facing loop. Leaving INC-7891 open for eng-infra to patch. If anything else pops up ping this thread or @support. :thumbsup:
